title: Convolution as Declarative Composition
description: Compose dot from map and apply, then convolution2 from dot and reverse, showing declarative versus imperative styles on the same problem.

steps.description: Reveal dot: apply + to the result of map * over x and y for elementwise multiply and sum.
Reveal convolution2: apply dot to x and reversed y.
Reveal test cases: both dot and convolution2 produce the same result 28.
Focus on dot: map * multiplies elementwise, apply + sums the products.
Focus on convolution2: reverses y once, then applies dot.
